fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields extracted from a NewsArticle ld+json block plus HTML body paragraphs; latest-mode records (S2-rss, site-wide 'Latest News' feed) carry title/link-style fields, including a full-body description. Upstream fields are passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html for articles, S2-rss for latest headlines, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_5xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Article dek/summary. Article mode: JSON-LD NewsArticle description, HTML-unescaped (some articles carry entity-escaped punctuation, e.g. —). Latest mode: cleaned (HTML-unescaped, tag-stripped, paragraph-joined) full body text from the RSS item description -- unusually, this feed carries the complete article body, not just a teaser.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, paragraph-joined from div.article-body > p on the article page (the JSON-LD articleBody field exists but lacks paragraph breaks, so HTML is used instead).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date, from JSON-LD NewsArticle.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date, from JSON-LD NewsArticle.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author/byline name. Article mode: joined name(s) from the JSON-LD author object/array (wire-service reprints carry the agency name, e.g. 'PR Newswire', 'Agence France-Presse'). Latest mode: raw RSS <dc:creator> text.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords as emitted upstream in JSON-LD NewsArticle (observed empty string on all sampled articles).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, from the JSON-LD NewsArticle image object (article mode only).

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: JSON-LD paywall marker (observed true on every sampled article -- no paywall found).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the RSS item (latest mode).

category.title: Category
category.description: Section name, from the RSS item <category> (latest mode).

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Lead image URL, from the RSS item's media:thumbnail/media:content (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
